sample_unit: patients in the validation and external test sets (100 internal, 75 AMC, 170 TCGA, 477 UCSF)

links.outcome: Performance of IDH prediction and report generation across internal and external sites
links.effect: IDH AUCs were 0.85-0.95 across internal and external datasets. Report generation fell from BLEU-1 0.50 and ROUGE-L 0.49 internally to 0.32 and 0.36 on the AMC dataset.
links.quote: In terms of RRG, the BLEU-1 and ROUGE-L scores were 0.50 and 0.49 in the internal validation, respectively, and 0.32 and 0.36 on the AMC dataset, respectively.

links.outcome: Neuroradiologist rating of clinical acceptability of generated radiology reports
links.effect: 37.8% of generated reports were superior or equal to the original reports. 91.0% were clinically acceptable, so about 9% were not acceptable.
links.quote: Overall, 37.8% of generated reports were considered superior or equal to the original reports, while 91.0% of generated reports were considered clinically acceptable by neuroradiologists.

screen.reason: Evaluates a newly developed multimodal vision-language model (Glio-LLaMA-Vision) for molecular status prediction and report generation via reader evaluation and external validation, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
